text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 52, September 08, 1936 ]
CONSOLIDATION OF OFFICIAL WAREHOUSE RECEIPT-PERMIT FOR DOMESTIC CONSUMPTION
OR EMERGENCY RESERVE SUGAR
Pursuant to authority vested in me by Act Numbered Four thousand one hundred sixty-six, it is hereby ordered
1. A consolidated official warehouse receipt-permit for domestic consumption or emergency reserve sugar,
covering the net weight, raw value, of the total amount of sugar comprising two or more individual allotments
or planter’s rights may be issued by authorized permit agents of the Domestic Sugar Administration at the
option of the mill company: Provided, That if the quantity of sugar included for any planter is in excess of one
hundred thirty-nine and forty-four-hundredths pounds, the mill company shall be required to possess written
evidence to indicate the consent of such planter.
2. The consolidated official warehouse receipt-permit shall be prepared in accordance with the provisions set
forth in subsections (a), (b), and (c) of Executive Order Numbered Seven hundred six, Baguio, April fifteenth,
nineteen hundred and thirty-five, as amended by Executive Order Numbered Eight hundred fifteen, Manila,
July twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred and thirty-five.
3. The provisions of Executive Order Numbered Seven hundred six, Baguio, April fifteenth, nineteen hundred
and thirty-five, insofar as they concern domestic consumption or emergency reserve sugar are hereby
modified so as to conform with this Executive Order.
